title: TaliCraft
description: TaliCraft is a fantasy-themed Minecraft survival modpack with world inspired by magical realms and ancient legends. Explore and face mythical lands.
body:
TaliCraft is a fantasy-themed survival modpack for Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1 (Fabric), built to bring deep roleplay, exploration, and immersive storytelling into your gameplay. 

In TaliCraft, every journey matters. The modpack enhances the core survival experience by weaving in mechanics that encourage collaboration, narrative choices, and meaningful progression. Whether you’re building a settlement, facing dangerous biomes, exploring hidden realms, or engaging in lore-rich quests, TaliCraft aims to transport players into a living magical world. 

Key Features:

Fantasy / mythic world and lore

Survival & immersion oriented

Encourages building, exploration, and social play

Compatible with both client and server setups

Designed for multiplayer with friends or community play
